title: Why is production broken?
fullTitle: It Works Locally. Why Is Production Broken?

scenes.narration: On the developer's machine everything works. The page asks the API for slash health and gets two hundred OK. Ship it.
Open the same deployed page from another machine, and the request fails. Not a four oh four, not a CORS message. A TypeError: failed to fetch. Connection refused.
captions: Remote browser: TypeError: Failed to fetch.
Connection refused — not CORS, not a 404.

scenes.narration: Follow the request. The page is asking one two seven dot zero dot zero dot one. On the remote machine that is its own loopback, and nothing there is listening.
captions: 127.0.0.1 means the remote machine's OWN loopback.

scenes.narration: Where did that address come from? The source reads import dot meta dot env dot VITE API BASE URL. Vite replaces that expression at build time with a string literal. Open the built JavaScript: the localhost address is in it.
captions: Vite replaces it at build time. The bundle holds the literal URL.

scenes.narration: The usual instinct: change the environment variable on the static hosting server. Done. The host process can see the new value.
captions: Set VITE_API_BASE_URL on the static host. The host sees it.

scenes.narration: The bundle cannot. The served file still holds the original localhost address, byte for byte. A static host serves files. It does not run the build.
captions: A static host serves files; it does not rebuild them.

scenes.narration: The fix is a rebuild with an API address the deployed browser can reach. Set the variable where the build runs; Vite stamps the new value into a new bundle.
captions: Rebuild with a reachable API URL.
The new bundle contains the new literal.

scenes.narration: Serve the new bundle and retest. The embedded address points at the API, CORS allows the static origin, and slash health returns two hundred.

Two things to keep. VITE underscore values are public client configuration, shipped to every visitor; never put a secret in one. And a server environment change cannot rewrite an existing bundle. Runtime configuration is an option, but a different design.
captions: VITE_ values are public. Never put a secret in one.
A server environment change cannot rewrite an existing bundle.
